decision: /port/ remains the canonical HUMAN PORT intake/router; 1.4 adds an AXIAL/Scale-Lens-derived focus aperture so one source can be routed whole or at an addressed focus through an explicit SELECT → OPEN gate.
laws: HEURISTIC CUE SUPPORT != EXACT SET SUPPORT != CONFIDENCE != AUTHORITY
ZERO SUPPORT DOES NOT FORBID MANUAL ROUTING
promotion_rule: Keep /contact/ simple. Promote deeper mechanisms onto /port/ only when they reduce real interaction/re-entry cost.
next_tests: ordinary use: route whole vs focused fragments and observe whether focus reduces repasting
ordinary use: override LIKELY when cue support is wrong
re-enter Port from a downstream tool and confirm source/focus restoration is useful rather than sticky
observe whether SELECT → OPEN adds useful deliberation or needless friction
do not expand cue grammar or add transport until ordinary evidence accumulates
delta: embed shared Field Aperture inline rather than opening it only as a floating inspector
route WHOLE SOURCE or CURRENT FOCUS
support TEXT document/paragraph/sentence/word and JSON root/level/leaf focus
show reproducible heuristic route-cue hit counts against the current route scope; these are not Constraint Surface survivor counts
separate route SELECT from explicit OPEN
persist same-session source/focus/scope/selected route for re-entry
record completed OPEN choice for passive preference evidence; do not log payload text
preserve Contact as a second explicit boundary before external Share/Copy
first_time_test: Paste one source once and reach the intended tool preloaded within one explicit route choice.

support_semantics.non_claim: Route cue counts suggest attention; they do not prove route compatibility, confidence, importance or permission.
